name: omnichat
description: Manage OmniChat omnichannel inbox from ChatGPT: conversations, email, leads, AI, integrations, and team after OmniChat OAuth sign-in.

interface.longDescription: OmniChat lets merchants manage omnichannel inbox and CRM from ChatGPT: WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Messenger, Webchat, email threads and campaigns, leads, AI settings, Shopify/Woo, Meta Lead Ads, Google Sheets, automations, and team — after signing in with OmniChat OAuth.
defaultPrompt: Show my OmniChat account overview and channel health.
List recent WhatsApp conversations that need a reply.
Summarize unread inbox across all channels.

com.openai.releaseNotes: v1.0.3: Removed ChatGPT secret-ingest tools (telegram_connect, connect/update_store_integration, create_ai_custom_tool_from_url). Replaced with read-only dashboard connect URL tools so OpenAI further-review blockers clear.
